lead: "3 selected" with the actions on those rows and a button to clear the selection, shown while rows of a table are ticked. `count` is how many are selected (0 hides the bar), the children are the actions, `onClear` clears. It goes with the `selected` of a [DataTable](/data-table); for the tools of the table itself see [TableTools](/table-tools).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Tick rows: the bar is above the table, in the flow. Clear the selection and it goes.

placement.title: Top or bottom
placement.description: `placement="top"` (the default) is a bar above the table, where you put it; `"bottom"` is below it: put it after the table.
placement.label: Placement

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: The bar is the `bulk-action-bar` slot (`bulk-action-bar.css`), with `data-placement`; the texts and buttons are Text, Flex and Button.

floating.title: Floating
floating.description: `floating` lays the bar over the edge of the table instead of in the flow: it takes no room, so the rows do not jump when it appears. With `placement="bottom"` put it right after the table and it sits on the table's bottom edge; with `"top"` put it right before and it sits on the top edge. `--bulk-action-bar-offset` sets its distance from that edge. Tick a row to see it. `floatingIn` chooses where: `inside` (the default) lays it on the table, over its last rows (its first rows for `top`); `outside` lays it on what is beyond the edge, such as the pagination below the table.
